input.free_text_description: The system operates in the messaging, microservices infrastructure domain. It serves User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include helloworld ui, guestbook, helloworld. Core business data revolves around Message.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to send and receive messages, so that I can communicate with other users in real time.
As a User, I want to manage helloworld ui operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a User, I want to interact with guestbook functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
As a User, I want to interact with helloworld functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
